_comment: ONE ORIGIN, ATTACH-ONLY BY DESIGN. :3050 is the switchboard and the only address an agent may use (AGENTS.md § 'Dev origin'; operator 2026-09-15: 'only work from 3050'). There is deliberately no runtimeExecutable/runtimeArgs: a configuration with a `url` and no command attaches to an already-running server instead of spawning one. Do NOT re-add a command to 'make preview_start work', and do NOT add a second entry on another port — if nothing answers on :3050 the pinned lane is down (`systemctl --user start cycleforge-lane@prod`), which is the operator's call. The :3051 warehouse-os worktree entry was removed 2026-09-15: it pointed into a different checkout and stood up a second origin nobody owned.
